PDF to Word

Pull the text out of a PDF into an editable Word (.docx) file, with one heading per page. Fast, free, and fully in your browser.

PDF to Word

Extract the text from a PDF into an editable Word (.docx) file.

Please note: this extracts the TEXT into an editable Word file. Original layout, fonts and images are not preserved.

Scanned-image PDFs contain no text to extract (no OCR is performed). Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file to convert.
  2. Click "Convert to Word" and wait while the text is extracted page by page.
  3. Download the .docx file when it is ready.
  4. Open it in Word, Google Docs or LibreOffice to edit the text.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it keep the original layout and images?

Correct. Only the text is extracted. Fonts, images, tables and the original page layout are not carried over — the result is clean, editable text.

Why is my scanned PDF's Word file empty?

Pages that are scanned images contain no text layer, so nothing can be extracted from them. This tool does not perform OCR.

Is my PDF uploaded anywhere?

Yes. The Word file is built entirely on your device; your PDF is never uploaded.
